measurementWindowUtc.precision: Minute-level observation window, not per-run timestamps.

scope: Disconnected hosted Chromium, warmed synthetic updates. Wall-clock delivery-to-DOM-commit and update-through-two-animation-frame observations; not CPU, exact paint, input latency, startup, heap, native BYOND, native LuaJIT or game FPS.

provenance.baselineDefinition: Hybrid: only workbench.lua comes from fe543e16f56032100b197f3d9452767a1db56e5b; shared harness, adapters, data model, CSS, build code and pinned dependencies come from f796d58e5126b6e88d3fa61e3a91f952dba26731. Not a whole fe543e build and not the historical lua-baseline route.

matchedLuaBuildInputs.note: Both arms use reviewed f796d58e shared harness, adapters, models and pinned dependencies. Baseline substitutes only exact fe543e Lua renderer.

lua-row-baseline.origin: Build-generated source hash manifest, independently checked against the stated Git source.

lua.origin: Build-generated source hash manifest, independently checked against the stated Git source.

svelte.origin: Build-generated source hash manifest, independently checked against the stated Git source.

react.origin: Reconstructed from the stated Git source for this report; the React build does not emit a source hash manifest.

provenance.artifactVerification: Recorded demo.js hashes match deployment provenance; all listed existing artifact bytes match the hosting Git commit. All recorded source hashes match the stated source Git objects. No rebuild was used to substitute later bytes.

method.browser: Existing visible cloud Chromium, reduced user agent Chrome/155.0.0.0 on Linux x86_64; exact installed patch version not captured.
method.uncapturedEnvironment: CPU model, device scale factor, power settings and competing cloud workload were not recorded; no exclusive machine reservation is claimed.
method.navigation: Fresh navigation before every run; this is not a cold-cache measurement.
method.trigger: Visible comparison controls; no injected evaluation.

scenarioDefinitions.catalog: Blank search and no selection. Each iteration clears one successive visible material flag; including warmups, recipes 0000 through 0034.
scenarioDefinitions.selected-first: Recipe 0000 selected via its rendered row before timing; its folio stays open and the recipe stays first on-page. Toggle the selected material flag each iteration.
scenarioDefinitions.selected-off-page: Select Recipe 0000, then rename the same source-slot/path identity to Recipe 9999 (selected off-page) and move its material-name key before timing. Folio/identity survive; rows 0001 through 0040 are mounted. Toggle the selected material flag each iteration.

clockDefinitions.deliveryToCommitSamplesMs: performance.now wall-clock interval around adapter.update until its DOM-commit promise resolves: React flushSync, Svelte tick, synchronous Fengari renderer plus promise settlement. Excludes subsequent frame waits, not browser scheduling.
clockDefinitions.samplesMs: The corresponding delivery interval through two subsequent requestAnimationFrame waits. It includes frame scheduling and is not an exact paint duration.

method.correctness: Harness validates visible mounted state, blank search, 40 rows, selected identity/on-page status, folio title and selected material state before/after deliveries. All 36 records passed metadata and sample-count validation.
method.outlierPolicy: Retain every recorded sample, in its original per-run order, without trimming or replacement.
method.summaryMethod: Independently recomputed from the 36 raw records. Median averages the middle pair for even n. P10/P90 use nearest rank: sort ascending, take 1-based ceil(p*n); at n=90 these are zero-based indices 8 and 80. Minimum and maximum retain outliers. Per-run and pooled summaries are descriptive, not independent statistical replicates or population significance estimates.
method.historicalSeries: Not pooled with earlier harnesses, the scan-guard A/B, layout QA or local synthetic timings.

artifactMeasurements.scope: Standalone production demo transfer bytes, including each runtime, shared fixture, adapter and opt-in harness. Not marginal production-island cost; React is already loaded by the production application.
artifactMeasurements.build: Bun 1.2.16, browser IIFE, production conditions, minified JavaScript with identical external CSS; Svelte compiler dev=false, generate=client, css=external, runes=true.
artifactMeasurements.luaRuntime: Fengari implements Lua 5.3 in JavaScript. Not WASM, Wasmoon or native LuaJIT. Lua source is parsed at mount.
artifactMeasurements.gzip: node:zlib gzipSync with level 9, each file separately; Node 24.19.0, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley-3246f1b.
artifactMeasurements.sharedAssets: System serif font stack; no font files redistributed. CSS hashes/bytes are identical across all four arms.

interpretationLimits: Only three rotated rounds per cell; the four arms were not fully counterbalanced. Shared-cloud scheduling and timer granularity make small React/Svelte timing differences uncertain.
Lua candidate pooled medians improve in all three scenarios, but selected-off-page P90 and maximum worsen. No universal or tail-latency improvement is claimed.
Two-frame intervals are scheduling-sensitive; preserve their outliers rather than reclassifying them as CPU or paint measurements.

This iteration checks benchmark state and a final selected-off-page screenshot, not a new complete all-layout/focus/accessibility certification. Earlier layout QA is pinned to fe543e, and the prior minor focus-outline edge limitation is not claimed resolved.
Results describe these exact source/artifact hashes, not later builds or languages in general. No startup, CPU, heap, exact paint, native-client, AAA-quality or native-game verdict follows.

Svelte is a provisional candidate for isolated protocol-preserving adapter tests and native acceptance, not production activation or framework-wide replacement. Retain the Lua experiment and observed gains without further tuning solely to force a win.
